newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner sees strong growth - Journal.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner sees strong growth - Journal.

text.p: In an interview conducted Thursday and published in Friday's Wall Street Journal, Time Warner Chairman Gerald Levin said the company's cash flow would increase at a "very solid double digit" rate this year.
Levin told the Journal the company will have the "highest growth rate in Time Warner history."
This despite Levin's prediction that the company's Warner Music group would have a flat year, the newspaper said.
Levin also is quoted as saying the integration of the $7.6 billion purchase of Turner Broadcasting System Inc has "gone much better and faster than even we thought it would."
